notes.title: Visualis Dynamics Update ! 🌌
notes.content:
Let's recap all recent news !

🌀 [b]Wind Dynamics[/b]
- You can now experiment with realistic wind effects on segments and triangles !
- Explore the dynamics of wind with new demo scenes !

⚙️ [b]Physics Engine & Simulation[/b]
- Realistic rope simulation !
- Realistic tidal effect simulation !
- New option to display scene gravity center
- Custom f(t) function support for dynamic object positioning
- Improved graphs integration, faster frequency

🌐 [b]3D Models & Meshes[/b]
- ASE models support ! internal structures and meshes LODs
- Example in Asteroid Tidal demo scene

📚 [b]Interactive Learning & Dynamic PDFs[/b]
- Dive into new interactive PDFs, crucial for understanding and learning !
- All equations in PDF are updated in real time with scene values !

🖱️ [b]GUI & System Improvements[/b]
- XYZ movement arrows for easier object manipulation
- Direct link on graphs for easy object selection
- 'Follow object' function accessible in objects list
- Out-of-range values are highlighted for better visibility
- Improved readability of texts in black theme
- Variable object colors !
- Shortcut keys in context menu for quick access
- AppData Local path integration for user files
- Various bugfixes on Interface, copy-paste and objects creation

Thank you very much for your support, your feedback is crucial for future Visualis Dynamics developments ! 🙂
Stay tuned for more updates, and help us promote interactive physics learning ! 🌠
